Capital costs (p.5) state NO currency year - nominal plant announcements of about 2007-2011; stored as 2013_USD (publication year), a flagged judgement. Table 3 production costs (sidecar) are in USD2009 (stated in its title).

Main file: one example, the ethanol-to-ethylene dehydration plant (reactor_ete, candidate archetype reactor_ethanol-to-ethylene): description, state, TRL, capex (range 1,100-1,400 plus the Braskem and Dow/Mitsui plant cases, each tagged [case]), capacity of the two plants, and the flow of 1.74 t hydrated ethanol per t ethylene. Sidecars (not loaded): _plant-list (Table 1), _life-cycle (Table 2 cradle-to-gate, not Scope 1), _production-costs (Table 3 levelized costs), _context (theoretical minimum energy 1.6 GJ/t, Solvay PVC-inclusive cost, market figures). Upstream ethanol production is not extracted here (see P10).

(1) Production costs disagree across the brief: highlights China USD 1,700/t, EU 2,600, US 2,000; p.4 text China 1,650, EU 2,500; Table 3 China 1,650, EU 2,570, US 2,060. (2) Table 2 GHG entries such as '1.0 ( - 3.1)' look like ranges but the bracket is the sequestered carbon. (3) Table 3 footnote 'b' (corn DDGS credit) is attached to the lignocellulosic ethylene ranges, probably meant as 'd'. (4) Table 1 capacities marked (b) are bio-EO/EG capacities, not ethylene. (5) p.4 'Patel et al., 2006 estimate 3.1 tCO2eq/t ethylene' - 3.1 is the sequestered carbon, not an emission. (6) Capital costs carry no currency year. (7) Typo 'A a consequence' (p.2).
